answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the mandated cost reduction and the contract expires in 14 days, making renewal or further price negotiation unlikely to satisfy requirements. The low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that meets the spend target, but prior evidence supports onboarding speed and invoice accuracy rather than delivery performance at near-capacity production. Verify both the low-cost-vendor record and the incumbent stability record before committing; condition any switch on immediate delivery-capacity and quality validation because the 94% line load leaves little recovery margin.
